rules.title: Filesystem path built from request data
rules.description: If a request-controlled segment reaches a path, ../ walks out of the intended directory and reads or writes arbitrary files.
rules.remediation: Resolve the final path and assert it is still inside the base directory; strip the path component with basename first.

rules.title: Archive extracted without path validation
rules.description: An archive entry named ../../etc/cron.d/x writes outside the destination directory (Zip Slip).
rules.remediation: Validate every member path resolves inside the destination. On Python 3.12+, pass filter='data'.

rules.title: Mutating route with no authorization decorator
rules.description: A state-changing endpoint with no visible authorization check nearby. Worth confirming by hand - authorization is the one class of bug scanners cannot decide for you.
rules.remediation: Apply the framework's authorization decorator, and check object ownership inside the handler, not just authentication.

rules.title: Express mutating route with no auth middleware
rules.description: The handler is registered with no middleware between the path and the handler function.
rules.remediation: Insert an authentication/authorization middleware argument, and verify resource ownership inside the handler.

rules.title: Record looked up by a request-supplied id with no ownership filter
rules.description: Fetching by a client-supplied id without scoping to the caller is the classic insecure direct object reference.
rules.remediation: Scope every lookup to the authenticated principal: Model.objects.get(id=x, owner=request.user).
counterexamples: const order = await Order.findById(req.params.id, { user_id: session.userId });

rules.title: CORS allows any origin together with credentials
rules.description: Wildcard origin plus credentials lets any site read authenticated responses on behalf of a logged-in visitor.
rules.remediation: Reflect only origins from an explicit allowlist when credentials are involved.

rules.title: CORS origin reflected from the request
rules.description: Echoing the Origin header back is equivalent to allowing every origin, while also passing the credentials check.
rules.remediation: Compare the Origin against an allowlist and echo it only on a match.

rules.title: assert used to enforce a security check
rules.description: python -O strips assert statements. A security check written as an assert disappears in an optimized deployment.
